usage_notes: In the Vietnamese Penal Code, life imprisonment is the most severe penalty after the death penalty (
). It is applicable to "particularly serious" crimes. Under certain legal conditions and good conduct, a life sentence may eventually be commuted to a fixed term (usually 20 or 30 years).
